_note: The Occult Monitor. The thaumometer in the recipe is the lens the machine is built around; its slot takes a thaumonomicon, which is what it reads with. An infusion altar's own pillar stone gives it a frame, a coalescence core reads the altar's aura, salis mundus binds the lens to the metal, and an auram crystal keeps the reading honest. 64 vis: the 1.12.2 tree puts this behind the infusion provider and gives it a cost in more than materials.
_crystal: The auram crystal is the only crystal the altar needs; it is matched on its aspect component, so any crystal carrying auram will do.
